text: Mobile app development involves creating software for smartphones and tablets. A key idea is responsive design, which ensures apps work well on different screen sizes. Developers must also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps run on several. After development, apps are published through app stores like Google Play or the Apple App Store. Performance is another important factor, as users expect fast, smooth experiences. Good planning and testing help developers create successful apps that meet user needs.
